name: Mistral Small
description: Efficient model balancing performance and cost for everyday tasks.
longDescription: Mistral Small is an efficient, low-latency model ideal for high-volume tasks that need quick turnaround. It provides a solid balance of capability and cost, suitable for classification, summarization, and text generation.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
from mistralai import Mistral

client = Mistral(api_key="YOUR_MISTRAL_API_KEY")
response = client.chat.complete(
    model="mistral-small-latest",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
